current_session_probe.conclusion: The already-running task did not reload the newly installed hook.

installed_package_refresh.why: The interpreter named by hooks.json ran an earlier build of this package that denied every gh pr create/edit regardless of repository. The reviewed adapter is scoped to Hermes work contexts, so the installed package was refreshed to the reviewed source.
installed_package_refresh.permission_doctor: MATCH for the mutating session thread before the refresh
installed_package_refresh.mechanism: uv tool install --reinstall <this checkout>, repeated in this session after each round of resolved review findings so the installed adapter is the final source (the receipt already named this checkout directory; the interpreter path in hooks.json is unchanged)

configured_interpreter_probes.cmd: make test && gh pr create -t t

review_findings_resolved_before_final_re: A failed read-only pr-edit pre-read now exits 3 (child failed, no update attempted) instead of 4.

The adapter now honours an explicit --repo/-R Hermes target on lines it cannot tokenise, both in run() and in the own-failure fallback, which also judges the payload's command string rather than the raw JSON, where the command follows a quote.

activation_required: Start or restart Codex so the hook configuration is loaded.
Open /hooks and review and trust the new non-managed hook definition.
Sessions already running before the package refresh keep whatever adapter build they loaded; only new sessions observe the scoped behaviour.
claim_boundary: This receipt proves installation, the direct behaviour of the exact configured interpreter for the recorded payloads, and the package refresh, not enforcement in any already-running task.
